lead.headline: McLaurin misses again and Monangai's rest day is turf toe
lead.deck: Thursday's reports were otherwise kind: Jefferson and Likely limited again, Addison and Kamara back at practice. Gordon keeps the flex. Nothing of yours plays tonight.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Terry McLaurin was not on the field for Thursday's practice, his second absence of the week and his seventh day without a session since the hamstring on 2 Oct. The projection still wants him in your flex by 2.3, and the practice reports, which are newer than the projection, say he may not play at all. Kyle Monangai's day off on Wednesday was explained by his coach as soreness after 30 carries; ESPN's Jeremy Fowler now reports turf toe and a status that is uncertain for one to two weeks. He was on your bench anyway. On the other side of the matchup, Ja'Marr Chase practised in pads. The rest of the day went your way. Justin Jefferson was limited for a second day and told a Vikings beat writer that playing in New Orleans is 'definitely the plan', though his coach has not said so. Isaiah Likely was limited again with the knee and groin nobody has explained, and the Giants' own site sees nothing that puts Sunday in danger. Jordan Addison came back from his hamstring, which makes him a usable fallback for Jefferson again, and Alvin Kamara practised with his back. As set you project 122.1 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 52% against Los Gigantes de Teca, whose Bucky Irving plays tonight. Leave Ollie Gordon in the flex. If McLaurin practises on Friday, make the swap; if not, do nothing. Juwan Johnson is still free and is still the tight end to add if Likely is ruled out. Nothing needs doing today.
